predictions.rationale: This is the core class for 'Critic' agents, which are the main implementation of design critics in ArgoUML. The class name and package directly match the feature.
Likely manages or coordinates multiple Critic agents, matching the 'simple agents' and background execution aspect of the feature.
Implements composite or complex critics, refining the core Critic functionality and supporting advanced design analysis.
Likely implements the control mechanism for running critics in the background, directly supporting the continuous analysis described.
Responsible for initializing the set of cognitive critics, directly supporting the feature's activation and setup.
Represents the suggestions or issues raised by critics, which are central to the user-facing aspect of design critics.
Manages the collection of ToDoItems generated by critics, supporting the workflow of design improvement suggestions.
Provides interactive guidance or step-by-step advice in response to critic suggestions, matching the 'advice of expert designers' aspect.
Tracks critics that have been resolved, supporting the lifecycle of design suggestions and improvements.
UI component for displaying ToDo items (critic suggestions) to the user, directly supporting the feature's user interaction.
